description: A gilded rowing barge carries a group of people in formal 18th-to-early-19th-century court dress across a harbour toward a stone quay. A man in a dark cloak and bicorne hat sits near a woman in a yellow gown. Oarsmen in white shirts row. Behind them, several tall three-masted sailing ships with furled and billowing sails sit at anchor. A steep rocky peak rises on the left under a dramatic cloudy sky, and crowds with torches line the waterfront. The painting is an oil-style image with no visible frame or text.
